# Support

## How to Get Help

### GitHub Issues (Bugs & Features)

GitHub Issues are for:
- Reporting **bugs** — Something isn't working as expected
- Requesting **features** — Ideas for improving NexLoad

GitHub Issues are **not** for general support questions or troubleshooting.

### Community Support

Before opening an issue, try these resources:

- **Documentation** — Read the [README](https://github.com/abir2afridi/NexLoad-Apk#readme) first
- **GitHub Discussions** — Ask questions and share ideas: [Discussions](https://github.com/abir2afridi/NexLoad-Apk/discussions)
- **Existing Issues** — Search open and closed issues for similar problems

### How to Search Effectively

1. Search [open issues](https://github.com/abir2afridi/NexLoad-Apk/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen) for keywords related to your problem
2. If you find a related issue, add a comment with your specific details
3. If no relevant issue exists, open a new one using the appropriate template

### Reporting Bugs

If you've found a bug, please use the [Bug Report template](https://github.com/abir2afridi/NexLoad-Apk/issues/new?template=01-bug-report.yml) and include:
- NexLoad version
- Android version and device model
- Steps to reproduce
- Screenshots or logs (if possible)
